standard_prerequisites: the property P on arrows of WAdm^count defined in lemma-finite-type-red of the same chapter: B/b -> A/a is of finite type for the ideals of topologically nilpotent elements
weak admissibility makes the ideals of topologically nilpotent elements open

finite type of ring maps is stable under base change
core_obligations: Prove that the property P on arrows of WAdm^count is stable under base change: for B -> A and B -> C in WAdm^count with B/b -> A/a of finite type, the induced map B/b -> A/a tensor over B/b with C/c is of finite type, where a, b, c are the ideals of topologically nilpotent elements
proof_roadmap: Weak admissibility makes a, b and c open ideals; the completed tensor product A (completed tensor over B) C surjects onto A/a tensor over B/b C/c with kernel a weak ideal of definition, whose elements are topologically nilpotent.
The reduction of the completed tensor product is exactly the base change of B/b -> A/a along C/c.
Since B/b -> A/a is of finite type, its base change C/c -> A/a tensor C/c is of finite type, so P holds for the base-changed arrow.
difficulty_reason: H2: a base change bookkeeping lemma whose content is the compatibility of reduction with the completed tensor product.
